Mission acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more, from the MLS®. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.
Mission market context, June to September 2026

Mission had 231 houses and 122 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 28 and 10 sold in the month. Acreages are a smaller part of those listings, so the market-wide figures below are the closest published read on the price pressure around them.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

blocks.text: Before you buy acreages in Mission
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: Is Mission a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Mission had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Mission?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Mission that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in Mission?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Mission homes?
faq.a: The Mission homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Mission market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.
